text.text: We help people build the rhythm for a healthy, longer life.
New York’s #1 Personal Training for Leaders
Private movement, nutrition guidance, and wellness conversations integrated into one long-term partnership.
Built for leaders who are ready
This is for people who've given deeply to their work and are now ready for health that gives back.
We work with entrepreneurs, executives, and creatives who want to move well, feel strong, and stay consistent without turning health into another project.

"I've been training with Rodrick for over 15 years, even before Core Rhythm Fitness began. His guidance has transformed my life, and I feel stronger and healthier than ever. Continuing my wellness journey with CRF has been one of the best decisions I've made!"

"Before joining Core Rhythm Fitness, I never realized how essential it was to connect my exercise routine to my spiritual life rather than just my ego. CRF has transformed my perspective, teaching me that fitness is about achieving wholeness and balance, not just vanity. This journey has empowered me to embrace a deeper sense of self, and I now approach my workouts with intention and purpose. I’m grateful for the holistic approach that CRF offers, which has truly enriched my life."

"Core Rhythm Fitness has equipped me with the tools to view myself through a healthier lens. Since joining, my approach to nutrition has transformed, leading to a profound shift in my mindset. My body feels revitalized, and my spirit is truly inspired. CRF has been a life-changing journey for me."

"After my diagnosis, my greatest fear was another brain surgery. CRF became my fight camp. Through their personal training and dedicated nutrition guidance, I released weight and built strength I didn't know I had. We did more than change my body, we changed my prognosis. I am forever grateful; Team CRF didn't just train me, they gave me my life back."

"At Core Rhythm Fitness, I truly feel cared for in a way that goes above and beyond. Their personalized programs are thoughtfully designed to meet my everyday physical needs, and I always leave each session feeling rejuvenated and stronger. It's more than just training; it's a commitment to my well-being."

"CRF isn't just a gym; it's my anchor. As someone who's constantly on the road, it's my non-negotiable for staying grounded, strong, and healthy. No matter where I land, I know the CRF community and method are there to keep me consistent and bring my focus back to what matters, my well-being."

"CRF didn't just give me a routine; it gave me a foundation. I learned to listen to my body, challenge my mind, and nurture my spirit. Now, even when I'm away, I carry that confidence with me. I have the tools to make empowered choices for my well-being, no matter where I am. CRF taught me how to be my own wellness advocate, and that's a gift that travels everywhere I go."

"Being at Core Rhythm Fitness is like having a dedicated team in your corner, guiding and supporting you every step of the way. It's incredibly fulfilling to know you're not alone on this journey. With their encouragement, I genuinely believe in my ability to achieve my goals and transform my life."

"CRF didn't just change my body; it changed my entire outlook. Here, I found a strength that was always within me, waiting to be unlocked. This place is my fitness church, a community that built me up until my body, mind, and spirit were not just better, but unrecognizably stronger."

#1 Private Personal Training & Nutrition for Leaders | NYC
Health that works inside your life
At CRF, we are the only studio in NYC that blends pilates, strength training, body conditioning, meditation, and nutrition to serve the whole person.
Open up your body. Build awareness. Feel like a human again.
Build strength and sustainable capacity. Not punishment, not burnout
Sustainable guidance from a dedicated partner who knows your life
This studio was built for leaders whose lives don’t fit “ideal” fitness systems.
Traditional programs ask for more time, more discipline, and more consistency than real life allows. When those systems fail, the blame often falls on the client.
We believe that’s a design problem, not a motivation problem.
Our work is built around rhythm: sustainable patterns of movement, nutrition, recovery, and conversation that adapt to leadership schedules and real responsibility.
Designed by experts, delivered with care

Rodrick built CRF on the belief that everyone deserves to live in a strong, healthy body, at any age. His approach integrates mind, body, and spirit through strength, lengthening, and empowerment, creating health that works inside your life, not against it.
Koray cuts through the noise with one focus: results that stick. He combines strength training, functional movement, and practical strategy to build bodies built for real life.

Ellie brings the discipline of an athlete and the artistry of a performer to every session. Her training blends strength, mobility, Pilates, and functional fitness into an approach that doesn't just challenge your body, it transforms the way you move.

Morgan helps clients build functional strength and longevity through Pilates. With a background in dance, she emphasizes the mind–body–spirit connection. Trained by Pilates for Performers in New York City.
Giancarlo supports clients in achieving their health and fitness goals through personalized, sustainable training.
Ashley bridges the gap between what you eat and how you move. She combines nutrition and exercise physiology into a whole-person approach designed for long-term health.

Alexis handles scheduling, enrollment, and all things member support at Core Rhythm Fitness, making sure your experience here is seamless from day one. With a background in client relations across healthcare, education, and the arts, she’s passionate about supporting genuine connections with every member along their wellness journey.
